## TPM Reflection

### Learnings

The committee discussion revealed important gaps in the current PRD:
1. Financial modeling needs to include conservative scenarios
2. International expansion costs are not accounted for
3. Technical architecture should be modular for flexibility

### Recommendations

1. Approve with conditions - require additional financial analysis
2. Develop more detailed cost breakdown including international expansion
3. Create modular technical architecture
4. Add detailed go-to-market plan
